news.contents: The Washington Commanders have opened the 21-day window for running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) to return from Injured Reserve on Tuesday, according to John Keim of ESPN. Croskey-Merritt has been on IR with a groin injury for the past four games, and this is the first week that he is eligible to return. The 25-year-old second-year back from Arizona can now practice with the Commanders this week, but he must still be officially activated from IR by this Saturday if he is going to return ...

news.contents: The Philadelphia Eagles designated running back Will Shipley (foot) to return from Injured Reserve by opening his 21-day practice window on Monday, according to Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Sports. Shipley suffered a partial tear of his plantar fascia in the team's Week 5 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars and has been on IR ever since, but if he looks good in practice this week, he could have a chance to be officially activated and play this Sunday in Week 11 against the visiting Pittsburgh Steelers. ...
